framework.title: Helical Research Framework
framework.title_zh: 生物与物理智能的螺旋式研究框架
framework.subtitle: One question, eight equal-weight areas: four pillars alternating with four connections
framework.central_question: How do physically constrained biological systems learn to allocate limited resources for adaptive intelligence, and which of these principles generalize across biological and artificial substrates?
framework.central_question_zh: 受物理约束的生物系统如何学习分配有限资源以获得适应性智能，其中哪些原则能够跨越生物与人工基底？
framework.provisional_hypothesis: Learning under physical constraints may restructure which computational degrees of freedom are recruited, when they are active, and what information they carry, rather than merely suppressing activity uniformly.
framework.unit_of_progress: The research programme, not an individual paper, is the unit that can complete a turn of the helix.
framework.classification_rule: A node is assigned by the object of inference: biology, principle, executable rule, or closed-loop agent. The method used does not determine the column.
framework.notice: Repository-derived nodes retain their source wording and readiness. Framework-derived future nodes are questions or gaps only and do not assert validated results. Column, cluster, and generation assignments are a revisable visualisation overlay, not changes to the underlying Claim Records.

generation_model.axis_meaning: Generations encode revisions of a scientific question, not publication year or evidential strength.
generation_model.advance_rule: A new generation requires a stated change in the question, mechanism, constraint, boundary, or discriminating experiment. More evidence for the same bounded statement stays in the same generation.

levels.label: Generation 0
levels.name: Foundation
levels.description: Seed questions and bounded results that define the current mechanism, abstraction, or diagnostic problem.

levels.label: Generation 1
levels.name: Translation
levels.description: Claims or open tests that carry a result across a column boundary or expose a constraint absent from the seed formulation.

levels.label: Generation 2
levels.name: Return frontier
levels.description: Explicit future questions and gaps needed to return downstream insight to a revised biological or behavioural test.

area_model.sequence_rule: The framework alternates pillar and connection areas in one ordered cycle. Pillar and connection describe function only; neither kind is ranked above the other.
area_model.interpretation: A turn is not four completed pillars plus optional arrows. It is eight equally necessary scientific areas: four knowledge states and four tested translations.

areas.scientific_question: Which measurable or manipulable biological result anchors this theme at this generation, under what system, scale, condition, and uncertainty?

requirements: The evidence is a node in the same cluster_id and generation with column=experiment.
The node is a confirmed Claim Record; kind=question or kind=gap never qualifies.
The record specifies scope, independent unit, evidence, boundaries, and a falsification condition.
The biological variable is measured or manipulated rather than inferred only from an artificial-system proxy.

areas.scientific_question: Which operational mapping turns the measured biological variable into a formal quantity or competing hypothesis, and what observation discriminates the alternatives?

requirements: A bridge_record for experiment-theory belongs to the same cluster_id and generation.
Its mapping_statement, assumptions, validation_evidence, and failure_conditions are populated.
Its discriminator has been tested by evidence that links confirmed source and target claims.
The bridge_record is explicitly confirmed and evidenced; status=partial, gap, or open does not qualify.

areas.scientific_question: Under explicit assumptions, which principle, constraint, or identifiability statement explains the bounded phenomenon and yields a discriminating prediction?

requirements: The evidence is a node in the same cluster_id and generation with column=theory.
The node is a confirmed Claim Record; kind=question or kind=gap never qualifies.
Assumptions, variables, applicable regime, and failure regime are explicit.
The result narrows possible mechanisms or provides a checkable theorem, prediction, or counterexample.

areas.scientific_question: How is the principle realised by an executable rule using only the information allowed by its locality and temporal-credit contract?

requirements: A bridge_record for theory-algorithm belongs to the same cluster_id and generation.
It maps a confirmed theoretical source claim to a confirmed algorithmic target claim.
The information-access contract, approximation, controls, and failure regime are tested.
The bridge_record is explicitly confirmed and evidenced; an intellectual analogy or status=partial does not qualify.

areas.scientific_question: Which executable learning or computation rule produces the target consequence, with what accessible signals, controls, resource needs, and failure boundaries?

requirements: The evidence is a node in the same cluster_id and generation with column=algorithm.
The node is a confirmed Claim Record; kind=question or kind=gap never qualifies.
The executable rule, independent unit, controls, and reproducible result are specified.
The claim is bounded to the tested architecture, data, protocol, and information access.

areas.scientific_question: Does the algorithmic consequence survive measured physical costs and changing perception–action conditions under matched performance?

requirements: A bridge_record for algorithm-agent belongs to the same cluster_id and generation.
It links a confirmed algorithm claim to a confirmed agent claim under a matched baseline.
Energy, latency, communication, memory movement, noise, and adaptation are measured where relevant rather than replaced by spike-count proxies.
The bridge_record is explicitly confirmed and evidenced; a planned deployment, question, or gap does not qualify.

areas.scientific_question: How does a closed-loop agent allocate sensing, computation, memory, and energy when action changes future data and resource availability?

requirements: The evidence is a node in the same cluster_id and generation with column=agent.
The node is a confirmed Claim Record; kind=question or kind=gap never qualifies.
The task contains a genuine closed-loop or physical constraint absent from the static benchmark.
The record reports a matched comparison, measured resource variables, uncertainty, and a failure boundary.

areas.scientific_question: Which downstream agent result yields a new biological intervention that separates competing mechanisms and changes the next seed question?

requirements: A bridge_record for agent-experiment belongs to the same cluster_id and generation.
It links a confirmed agent result to a confirmed biological prediction or experiment claim.
The biological variable, intervention, competing mechanisms, divergent observables, and falsifier are explicit.
The record is confirmed and evidenced and supplies a changed next-turn seed and delta; a proposed return question alone does not qualify.

turn_completion_model.completion_expression: A turn is complete only when all eight ordered areas are complete for the same cluster_id and generation.
turn_completion_model.no_cross_turn_borrowing: Evidence from another cluster or generation does not complete an area unless an explicit, confirmed mapping deposits it into the evaluated turn.

confirmation_contract.pillar_evidence: At least one node with kind=claim, or a boundary node backed by a canonical Claim Record, plus explicit confirmation for the same cluster and generation.
confirmation_contract.connection_evidence: At least one bridge_record with status=evidenced plus explicit confirmation and confirmed source/target claims for the same cluster and generation.
confirmation_contract.readiness_is_not_confirmation: readiness=claim_ready identifies a candidate record; it does not by itself complete an area.
confirmation_contract.validated_result_is_not_confirmation: validated_result=true distinguishes a result-like node from a future question in this visualisation; it does not by itself complete an area.

excluded_from_completion: Any bridge_record with status=gap, open, partial, planned, or question_only
A paper, asset, or source citation without a bounded confirmed Claim Record
A bridge inferred only from thematic similarity

strength_model.area_strength_definition: The count and evidential quality of confirmed supporting Claim Records or bridge evidence within one area.
strength_model.effect_of_subclaims: Additional confirmed subclaims increase the strength, density, or confidence display of that area.
strength_model.topology_invariant: Subclaim count never creates new areas, changes the denominator, or compensates for an incomplete area.

lighting_rule.off: No qualifying confirmed evidence for this area in the evaluated turn.
lighting_rule.on: The area's completion_contract is satisfied by qualifying confirmed evidence.
lighting_rule.intensity: May scale with confirmed subclaim count and evidence quality after the area is on; intensity never substitutes for another area.

next_turn_contract.seed_rule: The next generation must state a seed question that is materially revised or narrowed relative to the completed turn.
next_turn_contract.delta_rule: delta_from_previous must name the changed mechanism, variable, constraint, boundary, discriminator, or experiment.
non_advancing_cases: More subclaims support the same bounded statement without changing the question.
A return repeats the original biological inspiration without a new discriminator.

turn_completion_model.current_data_notice: This file defines how completion would be evaluated but asserts no completed turn. Existing claim_ready nodes, partial bridges, questions, and gaps must not be rendered as eight-area completion.

columns.label: 实验
columns.prompt: 生物系统实际上做了什么？
columns.definition: Claims and questions about measurable or manipulable mechanisms in real biological systems, including both seed observations and return experiments.
includes: Systems, scales, conditions, and time windows
columns.success_criterion: The biological variable constrains the computational problem or a perturbation distinguishes serious alternatives.
columns.failure_mode: A correlation is relabelled as a mechanism without an intervention or discriminating prediction.

columns.label: 理论
columns.prompt: 为什么、在什么假设下会这样？
columns.definition: Claims that compress biological complexity into explicit assumptions, variables, constraints, objectives, dynamics, or identifiability statements and produce discriminating predictions.
columns.success_criterion: The abstraction narrows what can be true and yields an observation that separates competing mechanisms.
columns.failure_mode: A flexible model explains any outcome after fitting but does not say what would falsify it.

columns.label: 算法
columns.prompt: 这一原则怎样成为可执行的学习或计算规则？
columns.definition: Claims and questions about executable learning or computation, especially local, online, recurrent, spiking, or event-driven rules with explicit information access and failure boundaries.
required_output: Accessible local, broadcast, and global signals
columns.success_criterion: The rule learns or computes under stated constraints and produces a reproducible, interpretable consequence.
columns.failure_mode: A spiking or recurrent forward pass is called biologically plausible while training still relies on unavailable global information.

columns.label: 智能体应用
columns.prompt: 它在真实资源与闭环环境中能做什么，又暴露出什么新问题？
columns.definition: Claims and questions about adaptive systems in a perception-action loop under measured or explicitly modelled energy, latency, communication, memory, noise, and sensory constraints.
required_output: Measured physical costs rather than proxies
A failure boundary or new biological prediction
columns.success_criterion: Physical deployment or closed-loop interaction adds a scientific variable absent from a static benchmark.
columns.failure_mode: Spike count is treated as measured energy, or a robot demo adds no new adaptive test.

bridges.label: 操作化之桥
input: System, scale, time window, and uncertainty
At least two plausible mechanistic interpretations
transformation: Map an observable to an explicit theoretical variable, constraint, or hypothesis
State which biological meaning is retained and which is discarded
Derive an observation that separates competing abstractions
output: Operational mapping between biological and mathematical variables
bridges.discriminator: Would a different biological mechanism produce a different predicted observable under the proposed perturbation?

bridges.label: 实现之桥
input: Normative optimum, dynamical principle, or formal constraint
transformation: Replace global quantities with explicitly available local or broadcast signals
Specify temporal credit, recurrence, and approximation
Test convergence, ablations, and failure regimes
bridges.discriminator: Does the executable rule approach the theoretical target without using information excluded by its locality contract?

bridges.label: 物理化之桥
transformation: Co-design the rule with the substrate and perception-action loop
Measure energy, latency, communication, memory movement, noise, and adaptation
Vary budgets, sensory reliability, or task state
output: Physical validity or revision of the algorithmic claim
bridges.discriminator: Does the claimed advantage survive measured physical costs and changing closed-loop conditions under matched task performance?

bridges.label: 返回之桥
input: An agent strategy, anomaly, or failure not obvious from the seed observation
transformation: Translate the downstream result into a measurable or manipulable biological variable
Specify competing mechanisms and their divergent predictions
Define neural, behavioural, and falsification readouts
output: The seed for the next generation
bridges.discriminator: Would the proposed experiment distinguish mechanisms and change the next abstraction, rather than merely restating the original inspiration?

clusters.label: Energy & adaptive allocation
clusters.label_zh: 能量约束与适应性资源分配
clusters.synthesis: The current record links a conditional Gibbs frontier, a bounded V1 information-per-cost association, and active-set restructuring under PopCV regularisation. It does not yet establish direct metabolic causation, measured hardware energy savings, closed-loop utility, or a biological return experiment.
clusters.question: When do explicit resource constraints favour selective restructuring of active computational degrees of freedom rather than uniform suppression, and does that principle survive physical deployment and return to biology?
gap: Direct metabolic power and causal biological perturbation are not in the current record.
No current Claim Record establishes measured hardware energy or closed-loop adaptation benefits for PopCV regularisation.
The agent-to-experiment return remains a future question.

clusters.label: Dynamics & identifiability
clusters.synthesis: Analytic and constructed counterexamples show that selected covariance, spectrum, rotation, and memory observables do not uniquely identify symmetric critical dynamics within the analysed model classes; FlyWire graph controls extend the non-uniqueness test to known structural reciprocity without identifying the true biological mechanism.
clusters.question: Which additional measurements or interventions make circuit mechanism identifiable when passive activity observables are shared by distinct recurrent operators?
gap: No current record specifies a biological perturbation whose outcomes separate the competing recurrent mechanisms.
The counterexamples have not been converted into a local learning-rule comparison.
There is no embodied or hardware-native identifiability test and no return experiment.

clusters.label: Learning history & state
clusters.synthesis: In the tested SG-EAP protocols, matched current conditions can retain different recurrent-interaction readouts after different training histories, and the matched N=100 runs share one switching order. The mechanism is not unique, the large-N timing boundary remains unresolved, and biological or embodied relevance has not been established.
clusters.question: When does learning history remain functionally visible after the current state is matched, and can that memory improve adaptive switching without becoming a hidden confound?
gap: A state-gated Oja-style comparator can reproduce the directional asymmetry, so SG-EAP is not uniquely identified.
No current Claim Record tests whether the history trace improves closed-loop recovery or adaptation.
A longitudinal matched-current biological perturbation and return bridge are still missing.

nodes.title: How do resource constraints shape neural codes?
nodes.statement: Which response statistics and learning routes preserve useful representations under explicit activity or metabolic constraints?

nodes.title: Expected-cost maximum entropy yields a Gibbs frontier
nodes.statement: For the specified response space and expected-cost constraint, entropy-maximising response laws form a Gibbs family along the active Pareto frontier.

nodes.title: Lifetime CV tracks calibrated information per cost in macaque V1
nodes.statement: Across five macaque V1 sessions from three animals, firing-rate-controlled lifetime CV tracked measured stimulus information per calibrated cost.

nodes.title: PopCV regularisation restructures the active set in tested SDTs
nodes.statement: In the tested static-image SDT settings, population-CV regularisation reduced evaluation CV, increased effectively silent coordinates, and preserved or improved task accuracy.

nodes.title: Does active-set restructuring survive physical deployment?
nodes.statement: Under matched task performance, does PopCV-driven active-set restructuring improve measured energy–latency–adaptation trade-offs in a hardware-native closed-loop agent?
nodes.source: Helix/Helical_Research_Framework_v1.md + framework synthesis; no validated result
non_claims: No hardware energy advantage is currently claimed.
No closed-loop behavioural benefit is currently claimed.

nodes.title: Does biological resource pressure selectively reorganise task-relevant ensembles?
nodes.statement: When sensory uncertainty and a biological resource variable are jointly manipulated, do task-relevant ensembles reorganise selectively rather than showing only uniform activity suppression?
nodes.source: Helix/Helical_Research_Framework_v1.md + framework synthesis; no validated result
non_claims: This is a proposed discriminator, not an observed biological effect.
The relevant metabolic variable and intervention remain to be operationalised.

nodes.title: Which activity observables identify circuit dynamics?
nodes.statement: Do covariance scaling and near-real fitted dynamics uniquely imply symmetric, critically normalised recurrent structure?

nodes.title: A covariance exponent maps to a parameter swath
nodes.statement: In the analysed linear model, each fixed covariance power-law exponent in the reported cortical range occurs along an iso-exponent curve over reciprocity and spectral abscissa rather than at one symmetric-critical point.

nodes.title: Near-real fitted eigenvalues do not imply symmetry
nodes.statement: A non-symmetric non-normal similarity transform of a symmetric operator can preserve its real eigenvalues and zero DMD rotation while passing the analysed covariance and memory diagnostics.

nodes.title: FlyWire reciprocity does not determine the two fitted observables
nodes.statement: Across the tested FlyWire graph controls and operating points, neither the DMD spectrum nor the covariance exponent was determined by known structural reciprocity alone.

nodes.title: Does learning history remain visible at matched current state?
nodes.statement: When gate and input are held fixed, can prior learning leave a measurable trace in effective recurrent interactions?

nodes.title: Matched-current recurrent interactions retain training history
nodes.statement: In the tested SG-EAP matched-current protocol, different training histories left different recurrent-interaction readouts under the same final gate and input probe.

nodes.title: Matched N=100 runs share one switching order
nodes.statement: Under the matched N=100 SG-EAP protocol, cooperation-to-competition crossed before competition-to-cooperation in all 27 tested runs.

nodes.title: Closed-loop value of matched-current learning history is untested
nodes.statement: No current Claim Commons record tests whether a history-sensitive local rule improves recovery, switching, or resource allocation in a closed-loop agent after the present state is matched.
nodes.source: Framework synthesis of app/static/data/mia-research-map.json; no validated result
non_claims: No embodied advantage of SG-EAP is currently claimed.
No biological learning-history mechanism is currently claimed.

bridge_records.mapping_statement: The V1 analysis tests a firing-rate-controlled association between lifetime CV and calibrated information per cost that is motivated by the frontier, but it does not identify direct metabolic power or uniquely validate the theoretical mechanism.
assumptions: The calibrated cost proxy is relevant to the analysed information-cost operating point.
CV is treated as a branch-local correlate, not a universal efficiency coordinate.
failure_conditions: The prespecified firing-rate-controlled association does not reproduce.
A competing tuning explanation fully accounts for the bounded association.

bridge_records.mapping_statement: The research map links the Gibbs-frontier programme to PopCV regularisation as an algorithmic transfer; the current records support the two bounded endpoint claims but do not establish a unique formal derivation from the theorem to the training rule.
assumptions: Population-CV regularisation is a relevant executable probe of allocation geometry.
Static-image SDT results do not by themselves establish biological locality or universal transfer.
failure_conditions: The released seed-matched SSNN aggregation does not reproduce.
The proposed mapping requires information excluded by the algorithmic contract.

bridge_records.mapping_statement: A hardware-native closed-loop test is required before active-set restructuring can be interpreted as an energy, latency, or adaptation advantage.
assumptions: Task performance and training budget can be matched to relevant baselines.
Energy, memory movement, communication, and latency can be measured rather than inferred from spike count.
failure_conditions: The deployment adds no scientific variable beyond the static benchmark.
The claimed advantage disappears under measured physical costs.

bridge_records.mapping_statement: A future agent result would need to yield a selective-allocation prediction that can be translated into a joint biological resource and sensory-uncertainty perturbation.
assumptions: The agent discovers a strategy not already assumed in the seed model.
A biological resource variable and causal intervention can be operationalised.
failure_conditions: The proposed experiment cannot distinguish selective reorganisation from uniform suppression.
The return merely restates the original biological inspiration.

render_hints.layout_note: Render the eight ordered areas as equal-width or equal-angle regions, alternating pillar and connection without visual hierarchy. Vertical rise encodes generation, cluster bands encode topic, and relation style encodes evidenced versus open translation. Do not persist computed x/y coordinates in this file.
